card.name: First digit of a dose number
card.fires_on: A single digit token that starts a dose number or count in dosing text, such as the 2 in 250, the 1 in 1000, or a lone 2 before 'divided doses'. The model is expecting the number to continue.

modes.label: Lone count digit
modes.description: A single digit giving the number of divided doses.

modes.label: Leading digit of a strength
modes.description: The first digit of a multi-digit mg amount in a dosing table or starting dose.

card.writes: It pushes toward tens words like forty, thirty and fifty and away from 'two', which suggests the model is handling a digit that begins a number.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a dose amount, like the 2 in 250 mg, in dosing instructions.
